title: Rollforward Scenarios & Stakeholder Alignment — Executive Readout
creator: Ava Chen
description: Purpose: Prepare a concise, decision-focused executive readout that contrasts three rollforward scenarios (Base, Accelerated, Defensive), surfaces the top 6 cross-functional risks, and maps each proposed ask to an executive owner and metric. This ticket produces the slide deck, an ask tracker, and a one-page summary for the Board/QBR packet. Context: After the last roadmap pass we received conflicting tradeoff signals between Dedicated capacity investment and Optimize features that materially affect cadence and short-term unit economics. Execs requested deterministic scenarios with clear asks, success metrics, and contingency plans.
agenda: 10m: Scenario walkthrough (Base | Accelerated | Defensive) — top level metrics and resource delta
8m: Stakeholder alignment matrix — who signs the ask, acceptance criteria
deliverables: Risk & mitigation appendix: internal doc + runbook link
Action tracker (living): GitHub issue template PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/roadmap/issues/1723
decisions_needed: Approve resource reallocation of 2 FTE-equivalent infra/ops to Dedicated capacity for Q2 (if Accelerated scenario chosen)
Approve temporary deferral of Optimize UX improvements for non-critical workloads under Defensive scenario
Sign-off on 3 primary rollout metrics: mean P95 latency, cost-per-token delta, successful fallback rate
scenario_summaries: Base (targeted investment): Maintain current roadmap cadence, prioritize high-impact infra optimizations. Metrics: ~3% unit-cost reduction, P95 latency projected stable. Resource delta: no new hires; re-prioritize two mid-sprint projects.

Accelerated (growth-first): Add dedicated capacity runway + 2 infra hires to secure throughput for prioritized enterprise deals. Metrics: ~8-10% unit-cost reduction after Q2 with higher near-term spend. Ask: $1.2M Q2 capital + 2 headcounts.

Defensive (cost containment): Pause lower-impact features, focus on quantization and cache improvements. Metrics: faster cost-per-token reduction, but delayed new feature launches and possible churn risk for mid-market customers. Ask: authority to freeze non-critical feature PRs for 6 weeks.
stakeholder_alignment_matrix: Product (Diego Ramos): Accountable for feature prioritization and success metrics
Engineering (Priya Nair): Accountable for infra execution, can commit to 2-week delivery windows for kernel selection and batching improvements
Revenue (Marcus Li): Executive sponsor for Dedicated capacity asks, owns commercial runway assumptions
Customer Success (Renee Ortiz): Will validate churn risk under Defensive scenario and own mitigations for key accounts
Finance (Samir Patel): Approves capital ask and defines reforecast cadence
